mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_events (app_name, user_id, session_id, event_id, invocation_id, author, final_response, partial, compaction_event, event_ts, content_text, event_json, created_at) VALUES (#{appName}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{eventId}, #{invocationId}, #{author}, #{finalResponse}, #{partial}, #{compactionEvent}, #{eventTs}, #{contentText}, #{eventJson}, #{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
